title: Create Sominul
description: A "create" modpack based on immersion in gameplay
body:
![logo2](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/56df877800602d751da08bc672cd07ff81fab21a.jpeg)
<center>
 
**an modpack that combines technology and ancient times** 

![log1](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0bd754888bccd0cacfe2a6af0686fc383c44ef21.jpeg)

**You are the only person, there is no one else around, without thinking for long you yourself understand that studying = life**         
 **_so you begin to wander the world in search of new knowledge._**
 
</center>

 ![log2](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/84f0dc10d56321367d0ff2fc463e4438affbccc8.jpeg)
<center>
 
## Features

</center>

- **❄️Seasons - not everything is so smooth: crops can't grow and it's cold outside**
- **⚙️Mechanisms - automation is the most important thing if you want to survive**
- **🔥Temperature - is getting colder, does it make sense to just start a fire? I don't think it will help.**
- **🐻Animals - you say: new food for me? And they think the opposite...**
- **🍃Sounds of nature - so calming, isn't it? you even forget you're alone...**
- **🌴Beaches - just look, isn't it beautiful?**
- **🗺️Atlas - why would anyone need a regular map mod when there's a book-sized map?**
- **💧Getting wet - you can't just swim like that anymore, right?**

![log3](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/dde1a1982ff5ffb5b4a8636644c09e98bc0787b6.jpeg)

<center>

## **brief description**

**the beaches and ocean are no longer just a bummer in the world, but a completely new experience.**

**Palm trees grow on the beach, and houses are located next to them, shells lie on the beach, and small coastal vegetated objects are scattered.**

**And in the sea, new creatures now swim, along with different types of seaweed.**

**In the far-off forests, there are not only foxes, but also bears, raccoons, birds, and other vegetated creatures.**

**And home decorations and furniture will transform your home from an empty shack into a beautifully decorated palace of art.**

**Well, now it's your turn to explore a new world of possibilities.**

</center>
